description: Header file defining classes and methods for managing H.265 video pictures and the Decoded Picture Buffer (DPB) in a media GPU context, including reference management and picture storage.

classes.name: H265Picture
classes.description: Represents an H.265 video picture (frame or field), including reference type and picture properties.

classes.name: H265DPB
classes.description: Manages the Decoded Picture Buffer (DPB) for H.265 decoding, storing and referencing decoded pictures.

methods.name: AsV4L2H265Picture()
methods.description: Returns the picture as a V4L2-specific H265 picture type.

methods.name: AsVaapiH265Picture()
methods.description: Returns the picture as a VAAPI-specific H265 picture type.

methods.name: AsD3D11H265Picture()
methods.description: Returns the picture as a D3D11-specific H265 picture type.

methods.name: GetReferenceName(ReferenceType ref)
methods.description: Returns a string name for the reference type.

methods.name: IsLongTermRef()
methods.description: Checks if the picture is a long-term reference.

methods.name: IsShortTermRef()
methods.description: Checks if the picture is a short-term reference.

methods.name: IsUnused()
methods.description: Checks if the picture is unused.

methods.name: set_max_num_pics(size_t max_num_pics)
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of pictures in the DPB.

methods.name: Clear()
methods.description: Removes all entries from the DPB.

methods.name: StorePicture(scoped_refptr<H265Picture> pic, H265Picture::ReferenceType ref)
methods.description: Stores a picture in the DPB with a specified reference type.

methods.name: MarkAllUnusedForReference()
methods.description: Marks all pictures in the DPB as unused for reference.

methods.name: DeleteUnused()
methods.description: Deletes pictures that are unused for reference.

methods.name: GetReferencePicCount()
methods.description: Returns the count of reference pictures.

methods.name: GetPicByPocAndMark(int poc, H265Picture::ReferenceType ref)
methods.description: Retrieves a picture by POC and marks it with a reference type.

methods.name: GetPicByPocMaskedAndMark(int poc, int mask, H265Picture::ReferenceType ref)
methods.description: Retrieves a picture by masked POC and marks it.

methods.name: AppendPendingOutputPics(H265Picture::Vector* out)
methods.description: Appends pictures pending output to the provided vector.

methods.name: AppendReferencePics(H265Picture::Vector* out)
methods.description: Appends reference pictures to the provided vector.
